title: The Squirrel and the Red Apple

paragraphs.text: Today is a sunny day. My family is at the apple orchard. The apples are red and green. They look very nice.
paragraphs.translation: 今天是个晴朗的日子。我们一家人在苹果园里。苹果有红的，也有绿的。它们看起来真好看。

paragraphs.text: Grandpa has a big basket. My little sister has a small bag. I have a red bucket. We can pick many apples.
paragraphs.translation: 爷爷有一个大篮子。妹妹有一个小袋子。我有一个红色的桶。我们能摘很多苹果。

paragraphs.text: A squirrel is in the tree. It has a big tail. It likes sweet apples. Then it comes down to us.
paragraphs.translation: 一只松鼠在树上。它有一条大尾巴。它喜欢甜甜的苹果。然后它下来找我们了。

paragraphs.text: The squirrel takes a small apple. It cannot carry the big one. My sister says hello to it. The squirrel is not afraid.
paragraphs.translation: 松鼠叼起一个小苹果。那个大的它搬不动。妹妹向它问好。松鼠一点也不怕。

paragraphs.text: Grandpa gives it a red apple. It takes the apple happily. Then it runs up the tree. We laugh and clap our hands.
paragraphs.translation: 爷爷给了它一个红苹果。它开心地接过苹果。然后它跑上了树。我们笑着拍起手来。

paragraphs.text: My bucket is full of apples. It is time to go home. We say goodbye to the squirrel. It waves its big tail. What a nice day!
paragraphs.translation: 我的桶里装满了苹果。该回家了。我们跟松鼠说再见。它摇着大尾巴。真是美好的一天！

quiz.question: What does Grandpa give the squirrel?
quiz.audioText: What does Grandpa give the squirrel?
